description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

OKX is hiring a Software Engineer, Card to build and maintain the payment infrastructure connecting digital assets with global commerce. The role focuses on backend card services, transaction workflow orchestration, ledger data, AI-assisted development, and card growth features.
Card Software Engineer building Java and Temporal transaction services for issuing, authorization, settlement, and card lifecycle features

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain reliable backend microservices in Java for card issuing, authorization pipelines, and settlement clearing
• Utilize Temporal to manage complex, multi-step transaction lifecycles and resilient distributed state machines
• Design and optimize SQL schemas and queries to ensure exactness and speed across high-concurrency transaction ledgers
• Integrate modern AI development tools into your daily workflow to speed up coding, unit testing, and problem-solving
• Deliver features for promotional campaigns, rewards, and card lifecycle management to support user growth

Requirements:
• 1–3 years of backend engineering experience proficient in Java (Spring Boot) and relational databases via SQL
• Direct experience or solid understanding of distributed workflow tools like Temporal (or Cadence)
• Strong background in Fintech with a solid grasp of card transaction mechanics (Visa/Mastercard networks, Auth, clearing, and issuing workflows)
• Proactive in using AI development tools (e.g., Copilot, AI assistants) to boost output and maintain high code quality
• Highly self-driven, quick learner, and excited to build secure financial products

Preferred:
• Experience working directly with Card Issuing processors or Payment Service Providers (PSPs)
• Broad understanding of Web3 concepts or crypto-to-fiat conversion flows
• Exposure to cloud-native stacks (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP)
